evidence.note: Systematic upfront reconnaissance: read helpers.py, start.sh, ALL ~15 public test files, conftest, run.sh, and oracle fixture JSONs, plus env/pip check — mapping the full surface the client touches before coding.

Re-derived load-bearing shapes from client evidence when tests failed: workbook listing must be list-of-names, FE (FormulaError) JSON serialization — grounded contract in what the smoke suite expects rather than prose.

Revisited sources on unknowns: re-read test_engine_public.py for exact VLOOKUP/MATCH/XLOOKUP cases and probed the live endpoint with curl to see actual error, confirming lookup semantics (e.g. XLOOKUP 4th-arg default).

Continued re-deriving shapes as new features surfaced: cell key tuple structure for ghost detection, ghost cell kind='spill', and re-read test_iter_public.py to understand iterative-calc fixed-point expectation.

Reactive-only semantic reconnaissance near the end (locale, pivot count, validation) driven by test failures; no independent Excel/openpyxl ground-truth probing, and locale edge cases remained unconfirmed/failing.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds level 5: it read helpers.py AND the entire smoke suite and oracle fixtures up front, extracting concrete request/response shapes, and it repeatedly revisited those sources when features revealed unknowns (52-54, 88-93). It approaches level 8 by mapping the full client-touched surface and grounding cell/patch/listing/spill/collab shapes in evidence, but the cross-checking of ambiguous Excel/openpyxl semantics is largely reactive to test failures rather than proactive external verification, and edge cases like locale separators and spill_range were left thin. That places it solidly between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 7.
